name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Wee.leaf_trapdoor
title: Leaf trapdoor: a false leaf gives A_phi - G = B R_phi - G from the succinct-LWE trapdoor
statement: Given the block identity B T_B[i,j] + W_i T_W[j] = delta_ij G of the l-succinct LWE trapdoor, an attribute vector w and R, let A_j := (sum_i w_i W_i + B R) T_W[j]. For every NAND circuit phi with phi(w) = 0, EvalF(phi, A) - G = B R_phi - G with the explicit R_phi = evalSim(...) built from R, T and w. This is the algebraic part of the leaf lemma (C1) of the witness-tree WE candidate: an unauthorized leaf yields a -G trapdoor without any trapdoor for B.
